title: gpt-loop job result
description: Posted as a bounded broker issue comment and stored complete under the platform GPTLoop state root/results/<job_id>.json. For migrated project work, work_ref identifies the canonical consumer-repository owner without granting workspace authority.

request_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact request body that executed. This is what makes an issue-edit race detectable rather than silent.

work_ref.description: Validated/normalized non-authorizing canonical work reference echoed from the immutable request.

status.description: Deliberately richer than ok/not-ok. `inapplicable` exists because a benchmark that cannot apply to the current inputs is not a regression; `environment_error` exists because a missing interpreter is not a project failure; `quota_wait` is a non-verdict account-window wait; `continuation` means one bounded executor slice ended while the packet remains durably non-terminal; and `hard_blocker` is a terminal packet-level blocker.

ok.description: True only when status is `success`. A convenience mirror, never the primary signal.

truncated.description: True when this payload does not contain everything, including when an individual step's output was clipped.

full_result_id.description: Retrieve more with action `read_result` and this id.
